title: Efc Perturbation Sector
description: This note presents the perturbation-sector prediction of Energy-Flow Cosmology (EFC) for weak-lensing amplitude as a function of redshift, summarized by an effective ratio eff(z) relative to a CDM baseline set to unity. EFC predicts a single redshift crossover at z ≃ 0.42 separating enhanced (eff > 1) from suppressed (eff < 1) lensing, with percent-level deviations bounded at approximately ±2% over 0.2 ≲ z ≲ 1.4. The result is posed as a sealed, falsifiable target for upcoming weak-lensing tomography.

cdm_baseline.description: CDM reference for the effective lensing amplitude ratio eff(z), as indicated by the "CDM (= 1)" baseline.

efc_crossover_condition.description: EFC predicts a crossover redshift where the effective lensing matches CDM, near z ≈ 0.42.

efc_percent_bound.description: Percent-level EFC deviation band (±2%) over the plotted redshift range, separating enhanced (above 1) and suppressed (below 1) lensing regions.

key_results.main_finding: EFC predicts a weak-lensing efficiency ratio eff(z) that crosses unity at z ≈ 0.42 with deviations confined to about ±2% over 0.2 ≲ z ≲ 1.4, implying enhanced lensing below the crossover and suppressed lensing above it relative to CDM.

sealed_predictions.statement: A single sign-changing crossover in the weak-lensing efficiency ratio eff(z) relative to CDM occurs at z ≈ 0.42, with enhanced lensing (eff > 1) at lower z and suppressed lensing (eff < 1) at higher z.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Tomographic cosmic-shear and galaxy–galaxy lensing measurements (e.g., DES, KiDS, HSC, LSST, Euclid) that reconstruct the redshift dependence of the lensing amplitude ratio relative to CDM.

sealed_predictions.statement: Across 0.2 ≲ z ≲ 1.4, the magnitude of the deviation in eff(z) from unity remains within ±2%.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: High-precision weak-lensing tomography and joint analyses with CMB lensing that constrain percent-level deviations in the lensing amplitude as a function of redshift.

kill_criteria: KC1: No crossover of eff(z) near z = 0.42 is observed—specifically, if tomographic weak-lensing measurements show no crossing within 0.30 < z < 0.55 at ≥3σ significance.

KC2: The measured deviation of eff(z) from unity exceeds ±2% anywhere within 0.2 < z < 1.4 at ≥3σ, or remains on one side of unity across the entire range at ≥3σ, contradicting the predicted sign change.
KC3: Independent tomographic CMB lensing or joint cosmic-shear × CMB-lensing reconstructions show a crossover redshift inconsistent with 0.42 by more than Δz ≈ 0.1 at ≥3σ.
